title: Guards per wanted level
question: From PR #46 (question 1): wanted levels add +0/+1/+1/+2/+2/+3 guards (wanted.guardBonus). Does level 3 feel noticeably harder without being hopeless? Should levels add guards faster, or add something besides guards later?
conclusion: Wanted level 3 does feel noticeably harder. It doesn't feel impossible, but you pretty much need to land a perfect landing. I was able to extract from a wanted level 5 train, just had to get lucky with the guard placement and be very sneaky.
